function.name: pet_profile_create
function.description: Creates a profile for a pet, including details about the pet and its owner. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

pet_type.description: The type of the pet, for example, 'dog', 'cat', etc.

pet_age.description: The age of the pet in years.

pet_breed.description: The breed of the pet, if known; otherwise, specify 'unknown'.

owner_name.description: The full name of the pet's owner.

owner_email.description: The owner's email address. Leave empty if the email is not provided.

owner_phone.description: The owner's phone number in the format (XXX) XXX-XXXX, such as '(123) 456-7890'. If not provided, leave as null.

vaccinated.description: Indicates if the pet is vaccinated. Default to false if vaccination status is unknown.
